source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note down all non-compliance issues.
3. Record all safety violations, referenced against applicable safety standards or regulations.
4. Document all discussions and meetings with the relevant personnel before and after the audit.
5. Include photos or videos of any non-compliance if possible.
6. Provide a detailed narrative of each issue and why the audit has failed.
7. Document any commitments made by the organization to rectify the issues identified.
8. Include recommended corrective actions and a proposed timeline for remediation.
9. Record any best practices or suggestions observed during the audit that could enhance overall safety.
10. Compile all documentation into a comprehensive report, detailing the findings, assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
11. Ensure the report is accurate, objective, and free from bias.
12. Store the documentation securely, in accordance with regulatory requirements and the company’s record retention policy.
13. Submit the report to the appropriate oversight bodies, management, and relevant stakeholders.
14
